player_intent: Online players receive the same map as the authoritative match instead of silently losing its admission payload.
acceptance_rule: Both WebSocket endpoints use bounded shared capacities before connection. The normalized deployed Relic Depot map survives an actual loopback transport byte-for-byte.

nodes.role: Uses the transport factory for authoritative multiplayer connections

visual_check: Join the exported browser to a patched local host and verify map reception without admission send-buffer errors.

system_delta.reason: Observed map RPC failure is caused by a payload larger than default WebSocket capacity. Configure bounded shared capacity, retaining existing transport and session ownership.
